Name: Zelda Fairy Box Companion
Author: MutfruitSalad
Description:
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/MH9XfV6F/Divider.png[/img]﻿
[size=5][b]Overview:[/b][/size]

[size=2][size=3]This is a very simple mod that just alters the textures of the fairy box fairies to resemble Zelda fairies instead.
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/SRKyX3rG/Navi-Gif.gif[/img]
[/size]"HEY! Listen!"[size=3]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] to function.

Mod includes:
-Navi (Ocarina of Time)
-Tatl (Majora's Mask)
-Tael (Majora's Mask)
-Ciela's Base Form (Phantom Hourglass)
-Purple Fairy (Link Between Worlds)
-Green Fairy (Four Swords)
-Leaf / Red Fairy (Phantom Hourglass)
-Neri / Blue Fairy (Phantom Hourglass)

The fairy box trinket has been altered to resemble the chests from the Minish Cap as well.
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/wT8zYtKV/chestdemo.png[/img][/size][/size][size=2]
[/size][size=3]Simply extract the mod zip into your mods folder and you're good to go![/size][size=2]

[/size][img]https://i.postimg.cc/MH9XfV6F/Divider.png[/img]
